name: popover
title: Popover
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova popover, fixed: The theme's shadow-md and shadow-lg are shadow-float, so its popup drops shadcn's ring, which doubled the shadow's hairline. PopoverContent takes Base UI's anchor, for a popup whose trigger is hidden. On a phone (narrower than 640px) it opens as a sheet from the bottom, as the platform's action sheets do: across the screen over a scrim that closes it when tapped, a handle to swipe it down by, clear of the home indicator, and `sheetTitle` on top; it stays Base UI's popup, its roles, focus and keys. `sheet={false}` keeps it anchored. No wider or taller than there is room for, as a menu; what is taller scrolls, keyboard-reachable while it does. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md). It pops in and out by the theme's motion-pop (in at 150ms on --ease-enter, out at 100ms on --ease-exit), not shadcn's 100ms on `ease`.
